title: Relative monoidal tuple cones with prescribed color values
statement: Use a monoidal infinity category $p:\mathcal V^\otimes\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ and the inert color projections $\rho_i:[n]\to[1]$ as in [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category], and relative limit diagrams on join cones as in [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone]. Fix $n\geq0$, let $I$ be the discrete simplicial set on $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $g:I^{\triangleleft}\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ have apex $[n]$, all boundary values $[1]$, and edges $\rho_i$. For any prescribed objects $v_i\in\mathcal V=\mathcal V^\otimes_{[1]}$, there exists a cone $q:I^{\triangleleft}\to\mathcal V^\otimes$ whose boundary is exactly $(v_i)$, with $pq=g$, and whose edges are $p$-cocartesian. For every specified cone $q$ with this boundary and base, $q$ is a $p$-limit diagram if and only if each edge $q(*)\to v_i$ is $p$-cocartesian. These assertions include $n=0$: the boundary is empty, the apex lies over $[0]$, and every such empty cone is a $p$-limit diagram. No ordinary limits, colimits or presentability of $\mathcal V$ are assumed.
